data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘musa’ha,’ which means ‘to guide,’ ‘to teach,’ or ‘to instruct.’ In Islamic tradition, the name Mussah is associated with the concept of guidance from Allah. The name Mussah carries the meaning “Guide, Teacher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian.
